claims: C1 when the assistant is uncertain about a significant portion of its response, it may add a qualifier near the relevant part of the response
C2 when the assistant is uncertain about a significant portion of its response, it may add a qualifier at the end of the response
C3 the qualifier explains the uncertainty

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of the assistant without defining it

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries guideline-level authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not itself state the authority level

concepts.name: significant_uncertainty
concepts.gloss: the assistant is uncertain about a significant portion of response R

concepts.name: qualifier_for_significant_uncertainty
concepts.gloss: Q is a qualifier that explains the assistant's uncertainty about a significant portion of the response

concepts.name: qualifier_near_relevant_part
concepts.gloss: qualifier Q is placed near the relevant part of response R

concepts.name: qualifier_at_end
concepts.gloss: qualifier Q is placed at the end of response R

asserts.read_back: the assistant may add qualifier % near the relevant part of response % when it is uncertain about a significant portion of that response
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), significant_uncertainty(A, R), qualifier_for_significant_uncertainty(Q), qualifier_near_relevant_part(Q, R)

asserts.read_back: the assistant may add qualifier % at the end of response % when it is uncertain about a significant portion of that response
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), significant_uncertainty(A, R), qualifier_for_significant_uncertainty(Q), qualifier_at_end(Q, R)

closure.reason: the clause grants a permission to add a qualifier in two locations; it does not prohibit adding qualifiers elsewhere, so silence leaves other qualifier placements permitted
